verdict.rationale: Unity documents an official MCP server that connects LLM agents such as Claude Code and Cursor to the Unity Editor. It first shipped in the com.unity.ai.assistant package, and a later probe reports it is now offered as the standalone CLI's fully supported `unity mcp` server mode, with the in-editor server deprecated. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent handshake verification (closed distribution, no keyless handshake possible), and stability is unproven given the beta in-editor server, its deprecation churn and the experimental CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: MCP server connects large language model (LLM)-based agents, such as Claude Code and Cursor, to the Unity Editor through standardized MCP tools.
`unity mcp` is the CLI's own fully-supported MCP server mode
Unity ships an OFFICIAL MCP server as part of Unity's AI tools (beta) inside the com.unity.ai.assistant package
